children: Intuit Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $21.45B and diluted EPS of $16.46, versus $18.83B and $13.67 in the prior year, as net income rose to $4.57B — a year-over-year improvement driven by strength across its small-business and consumer businesses.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
Total net revenue grew 14% in FY26, led by 16% growth in the small-business (GBS) segment and 11% growth in Consumer.
QuickBooks Online revenue rose 23% reflecting continued migration to Intuit's online ecosystem; online services overall grew 16%.
Credit Karma revenue increased 20%, supported by personal loans, card and insurance offerings; TurboTax benefited from assisted tax and consumer money services.
Operating income increased about 20% and cash from operations rose 42%, enabling continued investment in R&D and platform expansion.
Management recorded a $293M restructuring charge in 2026 related to an organizational simplification and recast segments, and moved Mailchimp to a standalone segment.
